description: Shared invented parity corpus for DEL-12-02 private-data redaction and export controls. Consumed by BOTH tests/security/test_redaction_export_controls.py (core python contract in core/security/redaction/controls.py) and apps/desktop/src/features/redaction-controls/redactionExportControls.test.ts (app-side TypeScript mirror). Every value below is invented placeholder data; no real private data, no genuine secret material, no protected standards content. Expected outcomes are decisions of the core contract; the app mirror must match them exactly.

statement_cases.description: Explicit blocking statements at every kind of position (DEL-12-02 AC-003; decision order steps 1-8). Each test expands every statement into every position, and every non-statement into the positions that name expected_decisions, by replacing the member named @statement with the statement's members; it runs each expanded payload, and each named case, in every setting through the generic route exporter on route_id and, in Python and TypeScript, through the redaction walk; the Rust mirror has the route only. statement_decisions lists, in order, the block_export decisions whose reason is one of steps 1-8, with paths written without the route projector's key prefix; {statement_path} is the position's statement path and {reason} the statement's reason. expected_decisions, where given, is the whole decision list. raw_cases are run as they stand in every setting, with paths as each entry writes them. route.decisions is the route exporter's whole decision list and walk.decisions the redaction walk's, with decisions_local_private for local_private with the wrapper's intent and decisions_local_private_without_intent without it, where they differ; route.mirror_decisions (and its local_private variants) is the Rust mirror's whole list, with the paths it writes; the mirror's entry takes a payload's sole member as its key and value, so every raw case carries it except raw-statement-in-a-root-array, whose payload is a bare array. route.payload, where given, is the controlled payload of an admitted export, and labels, where given, the privacy, redistribution and review recorded on the decision at that path. Each list is compared without regard to order. The route's decisions on leaves its projector labels by path rest on the projector's path-token rule. The raw cases whose names begin raw-leaf- hold that rule's leaf segment, read with '[' as a separator and ']' removed, and the exemptions that bear on it alone. The raw cases whose names begin raw-contract- hold the contract's worked examples. raw_cases holds 47 cases, 46 with mirror rows. Every value is invented.
